reviews.review:
This game rules. I have not actually played 12 hours because i left this game running for a while. But its pretty awesome. Would be cool if I could build or change the abilities that we get. Also I wish I understood the game slightly better other than I'm playing blackjack and letting the game kinda just do whatever.

Edit after finishing the game:
Pretty fun, but not super engaging. Would be cool to be able to replay the game once you complete Lvl 60. Rn if I try to play I just get put back to lvl60 then when i complete that it kicks me out again.

Other cool additions.
-Roll Credits after you end the game (even if they're short)
-Multiplayer on this would be fun
-Being able to swap out abilities and build a deck or stack that gets shuffled instead of the default abilities
-Either make New Game+ content or let me at least start again from Level 1
